2607.00671.title: Multi-Label Node Classification with Label Influence Propagation
2607.00671.paper_summary: Graphs are a complex and versatile data structure used across various domains, with possibly multi-label nodes playing a particularly crucial role. Examples include proteins in PPI networks with multiple functions and users in social or e-commerce networks exhibiting diverse interests. Tackling multi-label node classification (MLNC) on graphs has led to the development of various approaches. Some methods leverage graph neural networks (GNNs) to exploit label co-occurrence correlations, while others incorporate label embeddings to capture label proximity. However, these approaches fail to account for the intricate influences between labels in non-Euclidean graph data. To address this issue, we decompose the message passing process in GNNs into two operations: propagation and transformation. We then conduct a comprehensive analysis and quantification of the influence correlations between labels in each operation. Building on these insights, we propose a novel model, Label Influence Propagation (LIP). Specifically, we construct a label influence graph based on the integrated label correlations. Then, we propagate high-order influences through this graph, dynamically adjusting the learning process by amplifying labels with positive contributions and mitigating those with negative influence. Finally, our framework is evaluated on comprehensive benchmark datasets, consistently outperforming SOTA methods across various settings, demonstrating its effectiveness on MLNC tasks.
2607.00671.paper_summary_zh: 圖形是一種複雜且多功能的數據結構，廣泛應用於各個領域，其中可能具有多標籤的節點扮演著特別重要的角色。例子包括在蛋白質-蛋白質相互作用（PPI）網絡中具有多種功能的蛋白質，以及在社交或電子商務網絡中表現出多樣化興趣的用戶。對圖形中的多標籤節點分類（MLNC）的研究促進了各種方法的發展。一些方法利用圖神經網絡（GNN）來利用標籤共現相關性，而另一些則結合標籤嵌入來捕捉標籤的接近性。然而，這些方法未能考慮非歐幾里德圖數據中標籤之間的複雜影響。為了解決這個問題，我們將GNN中的消息傳遞過程分解為兩個操作：傳播和轉換。然後，我們對每個操作中標籤之間的影響相關性進行全面分析和量化。在這些見解的基礎上，我們提出了一個新模型——標籤影響傳播（LIP）。具體而言，我們根據集成的標籤相關性構建了一個標籤影響圖。接著，我們通過這個圖傳播高階影響，動態調整學習過程，通過放大有正面貢獻的標籤和減弱有負面影響的標籤來實現。最後，我們在全面的基準數據集上評估了我們的框架，始終在各種設置中超越最先進技術（SOTA）方法，展示了其在MLNC任務上的有效性。
